defaults.material_language: Original dark industrial frames, visible mechanisms and restrained power/control accents
defaults.surface_treatment: Hard pixel edges, shallow bevels and readable fasteners; no borrowed logos or text
defaults.silhouette_principle: The mechanism communicates the process; preserve the current distinct block geometry
defaults.item_icon: Machine items render their existing models/item/{id}.json; standalone icons use textures/item/{id}.png
defaults.gui: Preserve current text/in-world interaction; no new GUI texture is introduced

state_appearance.off: Not a separate registered state; reuse idle unless an accepted behavior requires more
state_appearance.running: Readable active indicator without changing the shared body maps
state_appearance.blocked: Distinct output/capacity feedback; not a universal error
state_appearance.starved: Missing input or power feedback on consumers
state_appearance.out_of_band: Retain the existing consumer condition state; no new T0 condition is invented

qc_rules: Legal lowercase identifiers and existing model/texture references
State list agrees with BlockCatalogue, not a separate runtime enum
Shared body texture references remain identical across states
Running and idle front pixels differ
Static placeholders have one frame and no animation metadata
Future composed frames preserve every pixel outside the approved animated-region mask
Human review still checks silhouette, readability, continuity and originality

machines.silhouette: visible hand crank on a compact frame
machines.gui: right-click crank and in-world state, no replacement menu
in-world state and recoverable output, no replacement menu

machines.silhouette: single-core workstation with readable front panel
machines.gui: core insertion and empty-hand retrieval, no replacement menu

items.role: physical controller; rating remains text/NBT, not a new item

candidate_atlas.rule: Unused cells stay transparent; do not independently regenerate the stable body for each state

multiblock_boundary: No T0 multiblock is approved; assembled continuity and port identity belong to the future T3 machine's own manifest
prompt_template: Create an original 16x16 pixel-art candidate for {component}, using the declared Grindless palette and {silhouette}. Preserve the supplied stable body exactly and draw only the named front/state layer. Hard nearest-neighbour edges, clear mechanism, no text, no logos, no copied game or mod imagery. Output only the declared atlas cells, with unchanged regions pixel-identical. This is a candidate for human QC, not a production-ready asset.
generation_policy: No calls without configured credentials; no automatic replacement of tracked assets; no unverified external material
